About the Role

As part of Strategy & Planning team at GoTo, you will play a crucial role in orchestrating business alignment and driving operational excellence across GoTo’s diverse business units. Your work will directly support leadership by ensuring key cross-functional initiatives are executed seamlessly. If you excel at bringing structure to ambiguity, managing high-stakes stakeholder cadences, and crafting compelling stories for executive management, this role is for you.

What You Will Do

• Orchestrate and facilitate regular business cadences, strategic reviews, and alignment meetings across GoTo leadership and cross-functional teams to drive alignment and strategic execution.
• Develop and synthesize high-impact presentations, executive memos, and management reports to communicate key insights, progress, and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Serve as a central coordination point within the Strategy Office, translating high-level strategic priorities into clear, actionable initiatives across business units.
• Partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to drive and monitor cross-company initiatives, ensuring clear ownership, progress tracking, and timely execution.
• Build and maintain financial models and business analyses to support strategic planning, decision-making, and performance evaluation.
• Support ad hoc strategic projects and initiatives as needed, working with senior stakeholders to address key business priorities and opportunities.

What You Will Need

• 4–5 years of experience in Corporate Strategy, Project Management, Product Management, or Consulting roles.
• Prior experience in a startup or tech company will be a plus
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to interact with and influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across a large and complex organization.
• Highly organized and process-driven, with the ability to manage multiple cadences, timelines, and shifting priorities effectively.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides, with the ability to structure and present data and insights clearly. SQL proficiency is a plus.

About the Team

The Strategy office team helps to bridge leadership vision with company-wide execution. Our team brings structure to complexity, from financial modelling, driving management cadences and building strategic narratives that move GoTo forward. Join us if you want a high-visibility role with a bird's eye view of the business and the chance to directly influence major corporate decisions.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. Job Purpose :
To ensure the organization's infrastructure and service delivery capabilities are optimally aligned with current and future business demands, this role is responsible for forecasting, planning, and designing scalable solutions. The position aims to prevent capacity bottlenecks, optimize resource utilization, and support sustainable growth by providing strategic insights and actionable plans for technology and operational resources.

Main Responsibility :
1. Analyze historical data, business forecasts, and market trends to accurately predict future capacity requirements across all critical systems and services.
2. Create comprehensive capacity plans and design specifications for infrastructure, network, and application enhancements to ensure scalability, reliability, and performance.
3. Assess current resource utilization, performance metrics, and system limitations to identify potential bottlenecks and propose optimization strategies.
4. Measure the effectiveness of implemented capacity solutions against defined KPIs and service level objectives, providing regular performance reports to stakeholders.
5. Draft strategic roadmaps and recommendations for long-term capacity growth, technology investments, and infrastructure upgrades to support business expansion and innovation.

Key Output :
1. Capacity Forecasting and Planning Reports Detailed analyses and forecasts of future capacity requirements based on historical data, business forecasts, and market trends.
2. Capacity Design and Optimization Strategies Comprehensive plans and designs for scalable infrastructure, networks, and applications that ensure performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
3. Performance Monitoring and KPI Reports Regular measurement and reporting of capacity solution effectiveness against KPIs and service-level objectives, with recommendations for improvements.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

wo-klbf-JR26_001087.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
